record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, project a training-only log-frequency feature, centered and standardized over items, into historical inputs without changing candidate embeddings. Replace each convolution block's second transformation with a causal GLU producing content and gates, retaining its residual path. Jointly use maxlen=64, six blocks, dropout=0.2 and LR=6e-4. Frequency supplies reliability information that the jointly trained gates can selectively admit; the shorter window offsets gate computation and the lower LR stabilizes gating. Preserve tied item embeddings, readout and pointwise loss. Save feature buffers and matching predictor architecture; retain one model/category and fixed seeds and training caps.

category_rationales.rationale: Project standardized training-only log item frequencies into historical inputs so the causal gates can learn when frequency is useful. Candidate embeddings remain tied and unchanged. The feature buffer and projection are saved in the single category checkpoint; the generated predictor imports this same model class and restores both.

Jointly use a 64-position window, six blocks and learning rate 6e-4, retaining dropout 0.2. The shorter window offsets the additional gate computation, six blocks retain contextual capacity, and the lower learning rate moderates joint feature and gate optimization. Training caps, seeds and routing remain unchanged.

Replace each block's second causal convolution with a content-and-gate transformation while retaining the first convolution and residual addition. This jointly trained NextItNet network can selectively admit frequency-conditioned context. The predictor imports the updated class, so convolution shapes agree with the saved checkpoint.
